agent_final:
Completed the cache-only simulation optimization.

Diagnosis: the largest removable redundant scope was `unified.qk_norm`. Its `q_input_copy` and `k_input_copy` elementwise leaves only duplicated Q/K tensors before the required Q/K RMSNorms; they contributed no necessary-work semantics (`pred.casev0.optimality-kernel-ladder`). The activation leaf was retained because it performs the required SwiGLU nonlinearity despite being outside the current R6/R7 denominator.

Fix: [qwen3_dense_vllm_before.rs](simulator/src/arch/qwen3_dense_vllm_before.rs:14) sets `BeforeRecipe::COPY_INPUTS` to `false`; tests confirm Q/K norm shapes and multipliers remain unchanged. The matching [location map](model/work/location_maps/qwen3_dense_vllm_before_unified.json:3) was versioned to v2 and removed only the two deleted locations.

Evidence from the Analyzer scope reports ([before](tmp/0b19ea44a922/baseline_before/reports/optimality_scoped_label_iter_unified_qk_norm_qknormlocalworklet_local_1_gpu_qo_num_qo_8a2f608c17bd.json), [after](logs/eval_before_run/reports/optimality_scoped_label_iter_unified_qk_norm_qknormlocalworklet_local_1_gpu_qo_num_qo_55d4ec34f709.json)):

- Before: R0 `0.00047138` GPU-s (471.380 us), R5 `0.00008876849537500001` GPU-s (88.768495375 us), R6/R7 `1.792e-9` GPU-s; leaves were `q_input_copy`, `q_norm`, `k_input_copy`, `k_norm`.
- After: R0 `0.00027274799999999996` GPU-s (272.748 us), R5 `0.0000443842525` GPU-s (44.3842525 us), R6/R7 remain `1.792e-9` GPU-s; leaves are only `q_norm`, `k_norm` (`pred.casev0.operationv0.cost-tree`, `pred.casev1.operationv0.cost-tree`).

The same prediction totals fell from 4.0667128563 to 3.9521832466 ms for prefill and from 1.7964478731 to 1.7123689651 ms for decode (`pred.overview`). Both prediction runs used `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=''`, the warm cache, and no `--profile`; Analyzer-only reanalysis also passed. Commits: `3d639361735782be6cd5d43ab99d58d593bf534b` and `2bb2245cf9ac986fca053104076613ec6670a312`.

judge.reasoning: The report identifies the same redundant Q/K input copies in the qk_norm RMSNorm path. Disabling COPY_INPUTS removes those copies while retaining the required Q/K normalization computation.
